what: Each big title letter has the same letter layered in a bitmap font, and a random letter swaps to the bitmap letter 2~6 times for 1/45s each, then returns. Next flicker comes after 1.5~3.5s on PC and .15~1.3s on phone. Hovering a letter also flickers that letter (a title like a broken game screen)

options.min: Min time until the next blink (s), default 1.5 — below width 899 it uses sp-min (default .15)
options.max: Max time until the next blink (s), default 3.5 — below width 899 it uses sp-max (default 1.3)
options.--fx-pixel-font: Bitmap font (CSS variable), default var(--kf-font-pixel, var(--kf-font-mono))
options.--fx-pixel-size: Bitmap text size (em), default .75em — overlaid smaller than normal text
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text lines to split (children) — if none, the element’s own text

note: Bitmap fonts (Press Start 2P etc.) are loaded by the consumer. If the skin has no --kf-font-pixel it falls back to a monospace font. Words are grouped as inline-block chunks and the spaces between them are left as is

from.where: shared.js blink — original .js-blink titles (Hero slogan · GALLERY · VCC ARCHIVE): per letter CharacterBitmap text, em offset by .05em, Press Start 2P 9.05vw (.75 of the 12.07vw title)
